thread:
priya: Heads-up — just ran the int4-onboard A/B (v2-int4 vs prod-v1) on a small 5% cohort. Seeing a small but visible fidelity regression on longform Qs, need thoughts before we bump to 20%.

 d e r e k: Can you paste the signal diffs? which metrics are drifting?

priya: Quick snapshot:

```
cohort: longdoc-heavy
samples: 1200
metric: exact_match-like (end-to-end eval)
prod-v1: 0.783
v2-int4: 0.770  (delta -1.66%)
p-value: 0.018
latency p50: prod 180ms, v2 140ms (-40ms)
latency p95: prod 520ms, v2 350ms (-170ms)
token-cost: -22%
```

priya: Also saw higher rate of short hallucination-ish answers (~0.4% -> 0.9%) on instructions slice.

anya: Hmm, delta ~1.6% on the longdoc slice with p=0.018 — borderline. Better latency and cost though. Do we have per-slice CI? Is that driven by a small subset?

priya: Breaking down by sub-slice — 80% of the drop comes from the >4k token inputs (only ~120 samples) where truncation/kv mismatch artifacts show up.

 derek: That smells like kv-cache precision/merging problem with the quantized kernels. Could be sequence-length handling in the new runtime path.

anya: For rollout gate suggestion: keep current auto-fallback rules: trigger if any of these for the cohort window:
- absolute metric regression > 1.5% AND p-val < 0.05
- hallucination rate increase > 0.5pp AND relative > 2x
- per-slice sample-weighted regression > 2.0% 

priya: With that, the longdoc delta crosses threshold on absolute but borderline p-val. We should probably shadow-fix the seqlen bug and re-run before promoting.

deploy-bot: reminder: canary policy set to 5% -> auto-promote after 48h if no trigger conditions met. Auto-fallback thresholds are active.

ops-bot: I'm flagging a temporary hold-override possibility for safety: if ENG-ML marks `hold_on_seqbug=true` the canary will not auto-promote.

anya: Proposal: pause promotion, mark hold, run targeted 4k+ inputs in an extended smoke (n=1000) to get power on that slice. If fix shows <0.5% delta on that slice, we can resume.

priya: Agree. I'll queue the extended smoke and open a ticket for runtime/quant team to triage kv-merge path. Tagging @derek for kernel investigation.

 derek: On it — I'll repro locally with the quant kernels and a recreated >4k sample. If I can reproduce, we'll patch the cache merge ordering quick.

anya: Also add a metric to auto-fallback config: track sample-weighted delta for the top-3 latency-cost tradeoff slices. That prevents cost wins from masking high-impact fidelity regressions.

priya: Added checklist in the thread and will update the canary notes.

priya: tl;dr — hold canary, run focused longdoc smoke, fix kv-merge if repro, re-run A/B. No ramp until slice delta < 0.5%.

anya: :thumbsup:

 derek: noted. I'll post an update in this thread after the repro attempt.

priya: thanks — will set `hold_on_seqbug=true` and attach the extended smoke report when done.
